subject: Remove trademarked wording on configuration file and individual configs (#29)
reason: The change is purely cosmetic: it renames the example config template redis.conf to valkey.conf, rewords comments in src/*.c/.h, updates the --help usage strings in server.c, and touches Tcl test-harness and utils/ scripts. No config directive, command, reply, replication, persistence, or cluster behavior changes; the only compiled difference is help-text wording, which no oracle or compared sequence can meaningfully test. No scenario is needed.
